method: Read-only Cloudflare adaptive groups, exact path/host/time filters; all six groupings below 10000-row cap
limitations: Adaptive estimates may lag current time and include operator/automation requests.
Browser-style UA includes our known real Chrome QA; headers identifying probes are unavailable in this dataset.
Referrer categories do not identify people or prove interest, installs, tool success or willingness to pay.
Downloads is a shared catalog page; the monitor route is a positive logging control, not demand.
Window begins after first product deployment; zero rows are not proof of zero people.
privacy: No client IPs, raw user agents, complete referrer hosts, tenant/session tokens or credentials exported.
